is_anopheles.evidence: The paper discusses Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus in West Africa (page 1, Abstract; page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions the kdr mutation in passing when reviewing literature (page 3: 'The pyrethroid resistance mechanism of kdr mutation had been found distributed in the M and S forms of An. gambiae s.s., [47-49]'), but conducts no genotyping.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No primary genotype counts, allele counts, or frequencies are presented in this review article.

african_field_population.evidence: No field mosquito collections or testing were carried out for this study.

is_primary_study.evidence: The article is explicitly labeled as a 'REVIEW' (page 1) summarizing vector-parasite interactions and the diversity of lymphatic filariasis vectors in West Africa.

sub_country_location.evidence: No new primary collection sites are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable as this is a review article.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data files are referenced or needed.

assessment.summary: This is a review article synthesizing information on the diversity and transmission competence of Anopheles lymphatic filariasis vectors in West Africa. It does not present any primary empirical data or marker genotyping.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers is false (no primary genotyping performed)
